kind: Measured packaging written by the author runner run_example.py. Not a native LivePortrait output format; contains no model- or author-written prose results.

scope.executed: Original LivePortraitWrapper HUMAN core APIs only, on CPU float32, from a full upstream checkout at the pinned revision.
not_executed: eye/lip ratio retargeting (weights loaded with checkpoint_S, networks not called)
scope.motion: Manual yaw offsets added to the inferred source yaw; offsets are input control values, not measured output head pose.
scope.frame_0: Generated by warp_decode at offset 0.0 after stitching; it is not the source image.
scope.parse_output: Original parse_output clips to [0,1] and converts to uint8; PNG frames are those uint8 arrays. MP4 encoding (yuv420p, libx264) is a separate later step.
scope.frames_private: All frames and keypoint arrays stay in the private --frames-dir; only public_frames and MP4 are in this output directory.
scope.timing: Wall-clock seconds from one CPU run on the operator machine; not a benchmark.

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.2-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
environment.ffprobe: ffprobe version 8.1.2-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

calls_counting: Counted in run_example.py at the wrapper call boundary after each call returned; no internal tracing.

video.input_frames: all 36 PNG in index order from <frames-dir>/yaw08
all 36 PNG in index order from <frames-dir>/yaw16
